items.d: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.

items.e: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) is an AI-agent-centric reverse engineering platform designed to bridge AI agents with powerful analysis tools like Hopper, Ghidra, and IDA via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It enables automated, deep inspection of native binaries, Electron applications, .NET assemblies, and web technologies entirely without source code access. By running locally and generating evidence-backed reports, it helps developers understand complex runtime behaviors and binary logic, facilitating the rapid replication of advanced application features in their own development projects.

It integrates a TikTok-style short video swipe mode, custom spider scripts, Telegram bot connectivity, and one-time share links, helping individuals easily build a highly efficient and private media library.

items.d: 统一管理和挂载云存储设施/Unified management and mounting of cloud storage facilities
items.z: NetMount 是一款基于 Rust 和 TypeScript 的桌面应用，通过 Tauri 框架和 React 构建，集成 Rclone 和 OpenList 实现云存储设施的统一管理与挂载。它简化了多云存储的配置流程，适用于个人及企业用户的文件同步与备份需求，技术亮点包括高性能跨平台能力和直观的用户界面。
items.e: NetMount is a desktop application built with Rust and TypeScript, leveraging the Tauri framework and React. It integrates Rclone and OpenList to unify the management and mounting of cloud storage services, simplifying multi-cloud configuration for individual and enterprise file synchronization and backup. Key features include high-performance cross-platform capabilities and an intuitive user interface.

items.z: 本项目提供Microsoft 365 E5账号API续订服务的Docker容器化部署方案，支持多种CPU架构，镜像轻量仅225M，可通过一行命令快速部署。具备邮件通知功能，定时检测账号状态并发送报告，适用于学习与个人运维场景，禁止商业使用。
items.e: This project provides a Docker containerized deployment solution for Microsoft 365 E5 account API renewal services, supporting multiple CPU architectures. The lightweight image (225M) enables quick deployment with a single command. It includes email notification features to periodically check account status and send reports, suitable for learning and personal operations, but commercial use is prohibited.

items.e: x-ui-pro is an open-source auto-installation script designed to deploy a lightweight, highly secure multi-protocol web proxy panel. Integrating Nginx, Xray, Warp, Tor, and Psiphon, it supports advanced protocols like VLESS and Trojan over WebSocket, GRPC, and XHTTP. Optimized for bypassing censorship, it offers multi-domain management, auto SSL renewal, and low detection signatures.

items.e: A serverless, Bitwarden-compatible password manager server designed for Cloudflare Workers. Utilizing Cloudflare D1 for storage and KV/R2 for attachments, it provides a completely free, low-maintenance, and highly secure personal vault solution. Features include core vault operations, live sync, TOTP support, and official client compatibility.

items.e: httpsok is an efficient SSL certificate auto-renewal tool designed for Nginx, Apache, etc. It enables one-command auto-detection, renewal, and update of certificates for wildcard domains and multiple servers, compatible with cloud services like CDN and OSS. Offers strong compatibility and monitoring alerts, simplifying operations and ensuring security.

items.d: 🚗 智能挪车通知系统 - 基于 Cloudflare Workers，支持实时位置共享和多推送服务
items.z: MoveCar 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的智能挪车通知系统，通过扫码联系车主而不暴露电话号码，保护隐私。系统支持双向实时位置共享，请求者可留言并获取位置，车主通过 Bark 推送接收通知并确认。利用 Serverless 架构实现免费部署和零运维，同时通过 30 秒延迟机制有效防止恶意扫码骚扰。
items.e: MoveCar is an intelligent car move notification system based on Cloudflare Workers. It allows users to notify car owners by scanning a QR code without exposing phone numbers, thus protecting privacy. The system supports bidirectional real-time location sharing, enabling requesters to leave messages and share locations, while owners receive notifications via Bark push service. Leveraging serverless architecture for free deployment and zero maintenance, it also prevents malicious scanning through a 30-second delay mechanism.

items.z: 聚合多个 AI 编码中转站与公益站，提供免费额度与一键配置脚本，助力开发者零成本体验 Claude Code、Codex 等顶级模型。实时监控站点可用性，自动更新额度与价格，支持多种协议，是 AI 编码探索的高效入口。

items.e: This project is an automatic localization tool for GitHub Desktop, replacing English text with Chinese via regular expressions. It is highly compatible with frequent version updates, supports selective replacement, preview features, proxy settings, and auto-update. Low maintenance cost, ideal for users needing a Chinese interface.

items.e: LX Music sync server with built-in web player, multi-source search, local library management, and cross-platform synchronization.

items.d: 实时监控网页变化，并发送通知（Monitor web page changes in real time and send notifications）
items.z: WebMonitor 是一款实时网页变更监控工具，支持动态抓取与灵活的数据提取。它集成邮件、微信、Telegram 等多通道通知，提供可视化界面与规则配置，助力高效实现网页信息自动化监控与告警。
items.e: WebMonitor is a real-time web page change monitoring tool that supports dynamic scraping and flexible data extraction. It integrates multi-channel notifications like email, WeChat, and Telegram, providing a visual UI for easy configuration and automated web info surveillance.

items.d: 以 MoonTV v100 版本 / Helios 为后端的 Android TV 客户端，针对遥控器设备优化
items.z: Selene-TV 是针对遥控器优化的 Android TV 客户端，基于 Compose for TV 构建。集成 MoonTV 后端，支持双内核播放、多源测速、多平台弹幕及手机扫码遥控，提供沉浸式大屏追剧体验。
items.e: Selene-TV is an Android TV client designed specifically for D-pad remote controls, integrating seamlessly with the MoonTV and Helios backends. Built using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for TV, it offers dual playback engine support (ExoPlayer/mpv), multi-source aggregation with intelligent speed testing, multi-platform bullet screen merging, and a convenient phone remote control feature. The app provides an immersive, metadata-rich interface with deep navigation optimization and robust caching, delivering a premium, cinema-grade streaming experience for smart TVs and TV boxes.

items.d: VLESS+XHTTP+TLS Auto-Installer for Ubuntu — Vercel / Netlify relay
items.z: 一键在Ubuntu部署VLESS+XHTTP+TLS代理，通过Vercel/Netlify CDN中继流量，有效隐藏服务器真实IP以防封锁。支持自动SSL签发与智能修复，快速构建安全、高速、难被过滤的匿名代理通道。
items.e: Automates VLESS+XHTTP+TLS proxy setup on Ubuntu, masking the server IP via Vercel/Netlify CDN relay. Provides one-click deployment, auto SSL, and smart repair for secure, high-speed, anti-blocking access.

items.d: 基于 Cloudflare 的 Serverless 聚合云盘。以 Telegram 为核心（支持 Webhook 直传与 2GB 扩展），并全面兼容 R2、S3、Discord 及 HuggingFace 等多存储后端。零成本构建你的全能私有数据金库。
items.z: K-Vault 是基于 Cloudflare 的 Serverless 聚合云盘，集成 Telegram、R2、S3、Discord、HuggingFace 等多存储后端，实现零成本私有数据托管。通过 Webhook 直传与 KV 优化，提供高效上传、预览与管理，适用于个人图片分享与文件存储。
items.e: K-Vault is a Serverless aggregated cloud drive on Cloudflare, supporting Telegram, R2, S3, Discord, HuggingFace, and more for zero-cost private storage. With Webhook direct upload and KV optimization, it enables efficient file upload, preview, and management for personal image and file sharing.

items.d: deadpool代理池工具，可从hunter、quake、fofa等网络空间测绘平台取高质量socks5代理，或本地导入socks5代理，轮询使用代理进行流量转发。
items.z: Deadpool是一款基于Go语言的代理池工具，专为网络安全测试设计。它能从Hunter、Quake、Fofa等网络空间测绘平台自动获取高质量SOCKS5代理，或从本地文件导入代理，通过健康检查与去重机制构建稳定代理池。工具提供本地SOCKS5监听端口，支持流量转发与IP轮换，有效解决渗透测试中IP封禁问题。具备统计信息展示、优雅关闭、周期性任务及账号认证等特性，提升代理管理效率与安全性。
items.e: Deadpool is a Go-based proxy pool tool designed for cybersecurity testing. It automatically harvests high-quality SOCKS5 proxies from cyber space platforms like Hunter, Quake, and Fofa, or imports them locally. With health checks and deduplication, it maintains a reliable proxy pool and offers a local SOCKS5 listener for traffic forwarding and IP rotation, mitigating IP bans during penetration testing. Features include statistics display, graceful shutdown, periodic tasks, and authentication, enhancing proxy management efficiency and security.

items.d: 监测RSS变动，并发送最新内容到微信、Webhook 和 Telegram, Discord, Slack, Amazon SNS, Gotify 等数十个消息通道。
items.z: RSSPush 是一款基于 Docker 的 Web 应用，实时监控 RSS 源内容变化，并自动将最新消息推送到微信、Telegram、Discord 等数十个消息通道。支持 HTTP 代理、关键词过滤、自动翻译等功能，可结合 RSSHub 使用，适用于个人和团队的信息自动化推送场景。
items.e: RSSPush is a Docker-based web application that monitors RSS feed changes in real-time and automatically pushes the latest content to dozens of messaging channels such as WeChat, Telegram, and Discord. It supports HTTP proxies, keyword filtering, auto-translation, and can integrate with RSSHub, making it ideal for automated information pushing for individuals and teams.

items.d: ⭐️ A proxy scraper made using Protractor | Proxy list Updates every three hour 🔥
items.z: 该项目是一个基于Protractor的代理爬虫工具，自动爬取代理信息并每3小时更新。支持TXT、JSON、CSV等多种格式下载，并按SOCKS5、SOCKS4、HTTP类型分类。适用于网络爬虫和匿名访问场景，技术亮点包括浏览器自动化、定期更新及代理测试功能。
items.e: This project is a proxy scraper built with Protractor that automatically crawls proxy information and updates every 3 hours. It supports downloading proxy lists in multiple formats (TXT, JSON, CSV, etc.) and categorizes by type (SOCKS5, SOCKS4, HTTP). Suitable for web scraping and anonymous browsing, key features include browser automation, regular updates, and proxy testing.

It supports custom audio source plugins, theme customization, local music management, WebDAV sync, and Xiao Ai speaker integration for smart home use, ideal for personal multi-platform music playback and management.

items.z: 基于 React 与 Capacitor 的超轻量多源聚合音乐播放器，支持多音源搜索、主流歌单导入及 B 站播放。安装包仅 2.5 MB，兼具 PWA 与原生移动端体验，并提供智能音源回退与数据同步。
items.e: Otter Music is a lightweight, multi-source aggregated music player built with React and Capacitor. Supporting extensive platform searches, playlist imports, and Bilibili playback within a tiny 2.5 MB package, it delivers near-native mobile and PWA experiences, featuring smart audio source fallback and seamless data synchronization.

items.e: This project provides automated subscription services for sports event live streams based on Cloudflare Workers, supporting TXT and M3U formats with authorization code access. It is suitable for sports fans to get real-time live event information, featuring free deployment, serverless architecture, and cross-platform accessibility.

items.z: RenewHelper - 时序·守望 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers 的全栈服务生命周期管理工具，专为周期性订阅、域名续费和服务器到期等场景设计。它提供公历与农历智能周期计算、多渠道通知推送、iCal 日历同步、资金流向看板以及 JWT 安全认证，支持 Serverless 和 Docker 部署，拥有精美的机甲风 UI 和响应式设计。

It features intelligent solar and lunar calendar cycle calculations, multi-channel notifications, iCal calendar sync, financial dashboards, and JWT authentication. Supports Serverless and Docker deployment with a mecha-style UI and responsive design.

Suitable for home routers and enterprise gateways, it balances stability and ease of use.

Its core strength lies in cross-platform consistency, ensuring efficient message synchronization and a robust, independent chat interface on every major desktop and mobile operating system.

With Docker deployment and QR code login support, it facilitates personal video library management and playback, making it an ideal choice for media enthusiasts.
